arxiv-2305-08930.title: On a discontinuity at the base of the transition layer located between the Keplerian accretion disk and the compact object
arxiv-2305-08930.creator: L. Titarchuk, I. Kalashnikov
arxiv-2305-08930.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by L. Titarchuk, I. Kalashnikov. We study the geometry of the transition layer (TL) between the classical Keplerian accretion disk (the TL outer boundary) and the compact object at the TL inner boundary. Our goal is to demonstrate using the hydrodynamical formalism that the TL is created along with a shock due to a discontinuity and to an adjustment of the Keplerian disk motion to a central object. We apply hydrodynamical equations to describe a plasma motion near a central object in the TL.
